description: Check recent website traffic and top pages from connected Google Analytics and Search Console data.

date_range.description: Time window to check. Defaults to 7d.

property_id.description: Optional GA4 property ID. If omitted, Refresh Agent uses the first connected GA4 property.

site_url.description: Optional Search Console site URL. If omitted, Refresh Agent uses the first connected site.

name: check_website_traffic
